mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate trend is downward.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it triggers aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in non-farm payrolls indicate labor market tightening that signals robust economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines by at least 0.1 percentage points and PAYEMS increases by at least 100 thousand persons.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) relative to prior 6 months signals strong consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 5% over the prior 6 months during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals extreme labor market tightness that increases inflation expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong aggregate demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases by at least 1% and HOUST increases by at least 2% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a federal funds rate decline signals aggressive monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.
